name: Gladius
what_i_did: Lies on its flat along X. A diamond-section blade with a raised centre ridge, widest at the guard and tapering into a long point; a half-oval guard; a grip with four finger ridges; a faceted ball pommel with a small cap.
good: Outline match 0.91: blade taper, guard, ringed grip and pommel all line up.
Blade and hilt are separate materials (BladeIvory and Ivory), so the blade can turn to steel without touching the hilt.
off: The concept's guard is a flatter flared collar; mine is a block.
The concept's blade has visible facets along its length; mine is smoother between the ridge and the edges.
creative_additions: A raised spine line down the blade so the fuller reads from above.

rounds.t: Camera search with roll, so the diagonal concept lines up; final render.

score.method: silhouette IoU after bounding-box normalising both masks; camera found by grid search on the model, so a guide
